subject: Implement HanaService for HANA-specific database operations
description:
Create `src/mamba_mcp_sap_hana/database/hana.py` with async service methods for HANA-specific features (calculation views, store types, procedures).

Methods to implement:
- `async def list_calculation_views(pool, schema_name, include_columns: bool) -> list[CalcViewInfo]`
  - Queries `SYS.VIEWS` where `VIEW_TYPE` indicates calculation view
  - Returns name, schema, column count, validity status
  - If `include_columns=True`: also queries `SYS.VIEW_COLUMNS` for each view
  - Includes informational note about analytic privilege requirements
- `async def get_table_store_type(pool, table_name, schema_name) -> StoreTypeInfo`
  - Queries `SYS.TABLES` for `IS_COLUMN_TABLE` and related fields
  - Returns COLUMN or ROW store type with metadata
  - Includes partitioning info and compression status
  - Adds implications text (column: FK support + analytics optimization; row: point lookup optimization)
- `async def list_procedures(pool, schema_name, include_parameters: bool) -> list[ProcedureInfo]`
  - Queries `SYS.PROCEDURES` for procedure listing
  - Returns name, type (SQLScript/R/L), parameter count
  - If `include_parameters=True`: also queries `SYS.PROCEDURE_PARAMETERS`

All methods use `asyncio.to_thread()` for hdbcli calls.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] `list_calculation_views` filters for calc view type from SYS.VIEWS
- [ ] Optional column metadata included when requested
- [ ] `get_table_store_type` returns COLUMN/ROW with metadata and implications
- [ ] `list_procedures` returns procedures with optional parameter details
- [ ] All methods use asyncio.to_thread()

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] No calc views in schema: empty list with informative note
- [ ] Table doesn't exist for store type query: TABLE_NOT_FOUND error
- [ ] View passed to store type: informative note (views don't have store type)
- [ ] No procedures in schema: empty list
- [ ] Procedure with no parameters: empty parameter list

_Error Handling:_
- [ ] Schema not found: SCHEMA_NOT_FOUND with fuzzy suggestions
- [ ] Permission denied: PERMISSION_DENIED with guidance

**Testing Requirements:**
• Unit: Each method with mocked cursor data
• Unit: Calc view column metadata inclusion
• Unit: Store type implications text generation
• Unit: Procedure parameter retrieval

Source: internal/specs/mamba-mcp-hana-SPEC.md Section 5.4, 9.3, 13.2
